findings.evidence: Lines 20–22 explicitly attribute the difference to “the image”; `unitSignature` at lines 97–99 maps integer units into the full sign group, so unrealized signs are its cokernel, as the PR description itself also states.
findings.fix: Replace the “archimedean half”/image wording with the precise statement that the cokernel of `unitSignature`, i.e. the full sign group modulo realized unit signatures, identifies with or contributes the kernel of `Cl⁺(K) → Cl(K)`.
findings.issue: The overview says the image of `unitSignature` measures the difference `Cl⁺(K) → Cl(K)`; that difference is measured by the quotient of the full sign group by this image (the kernel of the class-group map), not by the image itself.

summary: The declarations are documented, but the module overview misidentifies the part of the signature group measuring the narrow-to-ordinary class-group gap.
